test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Rahim had __to eat a humble pie__ in starting a row with his neighbour over a trifle.

options.text: To be punished for doing something wrong
To feel sorry and apologise for a mistake

solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'To feel sorry and apologise for a mistake'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To **"eat humble pie"**: To admit error and apologize for an act of wrongdoing (गलती मानना और माफी माँगना)

 
 
• **Example:** He had to eat humble pie after he realized he was wrong about the facts.
 
 
 
• **To feel sorry and apologise for a mistake:** (गलती के लिए खेद व्यक्त करना और क्षमा याचना करना) 
 
• This option 4 directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to acknowledging one's fault or error and seeking forgiveness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"To feel sorry and apologise for a mistake".**
